root.label: Peskov outlines Russia payment policy and Russia-India agenda

events.label: Peskov outlines Russia payment policy and Russia-India agenda

slots.name: national currency transactions
slots.sentence: Peskov added that 90% of transactions between Russia and BRICS nations are conducted in national currencies.

slots.name: rupee issue resolution
slots.sentence: The issue of Russian firms accumulating excess Indian rupees due to two-way trade with India in national currencies is being gradually resolved, he said.

slots.name: rare earths discussions
slots.sentence: Cooperation on rare earths exploration is being discussed between New Delhi and Moscow, Peskov said.

slots.name: Su-57 agenda status
slots.sentence: The issue of Russia selling its Sukhoi Su-57 stealth fighter jet to India is on the bilateral agenda, Peskov said.
